lines.text: College banned dogs, so he brought a bear.
This is Lord Byron, the poet, at Cambridge, around 1807.
His college reportedly had a rule: no dogs.
But the rules said nothing... about bears.
So he got a tame bear.
He wrote to a friend that it was the finest in the world.
Asked what the bear was for... he said it should sit for a fellowship.
